'''Lev Palik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] for the [[Recon team 05]], a special unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]]. Along with his spotter, [[Wren Cristol]], Palik and his teammates were ordered to take up a position near to an enemy bunker during a conflict on an unknown [[Planet/Legends|world]]. When a group of allied agents were sent to attack the bunker, they rendezvoused with Palik and Cristol, to learn more about it.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
